title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Grapesplash Prefilled Vape Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Grapesplash delivers the juicy flavour of ripe Red Grapes with a bright, slightly tangy twist. With hints of confectionery sweetness running through, this grape vape captures the taste of a classic fruity soft drink or confectionery — rich, deeply layered, and satisfying from the first puff to the last. Each pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, exclusively designed for the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. Together, they deliver up to 6000 puffs (based on personal usage) of consistent flavour and vapour. Powered by dual mesh coil technology, the pod delivers smooth vapour and heightened flavour clarity. Its automatic refill mechanism and leak-resistant design make the system clean, easy and reliable. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod provides rapid nicotine absorption with a tactile, yet comfortable throat hit, ideal for MTL vaping. Replace the pod and refill container when finished for a seamless and flavourful vaping experience.
